title: HUD layout and visibility
summary: Optional viewer layout, movement and visibility with complete cleanup.

blocks.text: Require ui.hud-layout@^1.0.0 with shared ui.windows icons. Create a layout for your viewport; optionally supply an editor toggle/reset, named movable items, viewer preference storage and responsive DOM roles. Fitting measures obstacles on layout changes and returns CSS-pixel rectangles without stepping a world. Instrument-specific geometry remains a read-only adapter.

Visibility receives caller-defined labels, selectors, defaults and optional container classes. External tools can bind their existing enabled state without a second store; dispose the returned binding on removal. The game chooses applicable groups and keeps a recovery path reachable. Editor/layout/visibility disposal aborts listeners, cancels pending animation work, disconnects observers, removes controls and restores borrowed presentation state. This preserves the existing narrow layout tools; broader HUD customization remains separate.
